name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod joined motorsport from a background in private security, having served for several years protecting high-profile individuals. His transition to racing came after a chance encounter with a team owner who recognized Alistair's meticulous nature and ability to handle stressful situations. He's known for his calm demeanor and thorough approach to risk assessment, ensuring all safety protocols are rigorously followed.

Alistair values order and precision above all else. He approaches security not just as a reactive measure, but as a proactive strategy to prevent incidents before they occur. His dedication to detail often uncovers potential vulnerabilities that others might overlook. Despite his serious nature, he has a dry wit that occasionally surfaces, much to the amusement of his colleagues. Alistair's background gives him a different perspective and he is constantly striving to improve and learn new skills.

physical.description: Alistair is a stocky man with a stern, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook.
Insists on performing a personal security check of his office every morning.
Has a habit of quietly humming Scottish folk tunes when concentrating.
